title: As-Samad: The Divine Name That Appears Only Once in the Quran
excerpt: As-Samad occurs a single time in the whole Quran, at 112:2, and the earliest scholars of Islam recorded at least seven different readings of what it means. Al-Tabari lists them all, then settles the question with a line of pre-Islamic poetry.
seo_title: As-Samad: Meaning of the Divine Name (Quran 112:2)
seo_description: As-Samad appears once in the Quran, at 112:2. Al-Tabari records seven early readings of the name and settles it with pre-Islamic poetry. What it means.
